newsitem.title: PERU: Peru 42-day CDs draw 14.53 pct avg yield at sale.
newsitem.headline: Peru 42-day CDs draw 14.53 pct avg yield at sale.

text.p: The Central Reserve Bank of Peru said Tuesday it accepted bids for 42-day Certificates of Deposit (CDs) worth 45.0 million soles at an effective average annual rate of 14.53 percent during a bank auction BCQZ.
The CDs have a September 18 starting date.
The accepted bids had a minimum rate of 13.80 percent and a maximum rate 14.80 percent, the bank said.
At the last auction on September 12, 28-day CDs drew an average yield of 14.32 percent.
At Tuesday's auction, the bank said it received bids on the CDs totalling 63.5 million soles.
The bank had offered 45.0 million soles worth of CDs.
The average effective annual interest rate for the certificates is used as an informal indicator for interest rates in the Peruvian financial system.
-- Saul Hudson, Lima newsroom, 511 221-2134 REUTER SH
